name: Tactile Foley: Paper, Pen, Tape & Desk
when_to_use: Paper-cut, scrapbook or ransom-note graphics, highlighter swipes on headlines, notes or cards pinned up, checkmarks drawn, 'rip up the old way', receipts, unboxing.

sounds.name: Quick Scratch Stroke 01
sounds.desc: Likely a short, raspy 140 ms scratch with a quick decay; use it for a tiny marker tick or a checkmark being drawn.

sounds.name: Quick Scratch Stroke 02
sounds.desc: Likely a brighter 140 ms scratch that swells toward its end; use it for a quick underline or highlighter flick on text.

sounds.name: Quick Scratch Stroke 03
sounds.desc: A longer, quieter 0.3 s scratch with a smooth decay; use it for a marker circling a word or a quick doodle drawing on.

sounds.name: Quick Scratch Stroke 04
sounds.desc: A sustained 0.3 s scratch that holds its level before decaying; use it for a highlighter swipe across a headline or a scribble fill.

sounds.name: Quick Scratch Stroke 05
sounds.desc: A very bright, hissy 120 ms scratch fragment that starts and stops at full level; use it only as a layer under a fast marker stroke.
